text: {"memo": "PFIZER INC (PFE) delivered strong performance in FY2024, with revenue reaching $63.63 billion, up from $59.55 billion in FY2023. Net income surged to $8.03 billion, compared with $2.12 billion a year earlier, and diluted EPS rose to $1.41 per share from $0.37. Operating cash flow improved to $12.74 billion, exceeding the $8.70 billion generated in FY2023. The substantial increase in profitability and cash generation reflects the company’s pipeline success and cost\u2011efficiency initiatives. Margins tightened as higher sales translated into a markedly higher net income margin, underscoring improved operational leverage. The robust cash flow position supports continued investment in R&D and potential shareholder returns. Overall, the FY2024 results demonstrate a clear acceleration in earnings and cash generation, positioning PFE for sustained growth.\n\nView: Strong earnings acceleration and cash flow growth support a buy rating on PFE."}
